title: Don’t use Tickeron ai services
author: FollowingRecent1704
selftext:
[Tickeron.com](http://Tickeron.com) — Unwanted Annual Auto-Renewal and Refund Refused



Rating: 1/5



My Tickeron subscription automatically renewed for another full year, resulting in a charge I did not intend to make. After discovering the charge, I contacted Tickeron, explained that the renewal was unintentional, and requested a full refund. Tickeron refused my refund request.



I understand that automatic renewals may be part of subscription terms, but I believe companies should offer reasonable solutions for unintended annual renewals.



I am extremely disappointed and encourage potential customers to carefully review Tickeron's renewal settings, cancellation deadlines, and refund policy.



I publicly request that Tickeron reconsider its decision and issue a full refund. Until this is resolved, I cannot recommend this company.

comments.author: QuanTradin
comments.body: if you paid by card, ask your bank about disputing it as an unwanted renewal. a quick cancel plus a refused refund is the kind of case they often side with you on.
